0:
if [ ! -f "/data/warpgate.yaml" ]; then
  echo "Initializing Warpgate..."
  warpgate unattended-setup --data-path /data --http-port 8888 --ssh-port 2222 --mysql-port 33306 --postgres-port 55432
else
  echo "Warpgate already initialized, starting normally..."
  warpgate run
fi
(ip rule del table 51820; ip -6 rule del table 51820) || true

cd /app
pip install --no-cache-dir --target /tmp/packages -r requirements.txt
export PYTHONPATH="/tmp/packages:$PYTHONPATH"
python app.py

gamerule doFireTick false
gamerule playersSleepingPercentage 0
scoreboard objectives setdisplay list ts_Deaths

/hr/ghcr.io-piraeusdatastore-helm-charts.title: snapshot-controller helm release
/hr/ghcr.io-piraeusdatastore-helm-charts.name: snapshot-controller
/hr/ghcr.io-piraeusdatastore-helm-charts.doc: Snapshot Controller deploys the Kubernetes snapshot-controller, a required component for CSI volume snapshotting. It manages the lifecycle of VolumeSnapshots, enabling the creation, listing, and deletion of snapshots. The controller is CSI-agnostic, meaning it works with any CSI driver that supports the snapshot API, providing a standardized way to handle persistent volume snapshots in Kubernetes clusters.
